body:
First raised: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles), during the source and boundary review in #405.

## Finding

The pinned geoBoundaries Chile ADM3 feature `31580391B33082267781919` (Isla de Pascua commune, boundary year 2020) contains a small detached component near Sala y Gómez. Chile Law 16,441 defines Isla de Pascua and Sala y Gómez in the same department/commune-subdelegation. At the fresh-main baseline reviewed by #405, the atlas location footprint contains the Rapa Nui component and has zero overlap with the detached source component. This is a specific discrepancy to investigate, not yet an instruction to alter production geometry: the location record's current point and any other member/geocoding effects must be checked first, and the administrative source's purpose and completeness must be confirmed.

Evidence and reproducible controls are preserved in #405's `data/regional-review/regional-review-14a242c4cb0781a7/` packet. See its `location-assessments.csv`, `area-assessments.csv`, `geometry-controls.json`, `geometry-comparison.json`, `references.md`, and `source/provenance.json`. The original exact source feature extract has SHA-256 `fb0ea671f05a6334ec7a867ca5cb46fcedb63c5b3cc25a39115f5879c73986cb`; the full nationwide geoBoundaries source is 171,783,952 bytes and is reproducible from the recorded LFS OID `f3833ce1965394ae705e3793b50bdd007775b43da604251871deffed04f3bffd`. Its small remote component is `[-105.366628,-26.475196,-105.360062,-26.469933]`, area 162,819.521 m² under the packet's pinned WGS84 helper; intersection with the current footprint is 0 m². The current Rapa Nui component does overlap the source. Law citation and source-vintage/license caveats are in `references.md`.

## Bounded scope

Review only subject `gb:CHL:ADM3:31580391B33082267781919` and the exact existing atlas feature/current location metadata and immediate province/area relationships needed to determine its role. Keep the existing location ID, parent ID, historical identity and release pins. Establish whether the official legal unit includes the remote component, what the atlas location is intended to represent, whether its current point/geocoding and any other relevant member depend on Sala y Gómez, and whether the source component should enter this location, another existing location, or remain only in its source-defined administrative extent. Record source vintage, license, original retrieval/restoration information, exact hashes, reproducible analysis and uncertainty.

This is geography evidence/proposal work only. Do not change core geography, release pins, production data, or authorize an import. If the evidence supports a correction, write the engineering handoff and exact expected consequences in the owned packet; engineering will own implementation and later regional revalidation. Do not claim the whole Easter Island/South-Central Pacific region is approved.

## Acceptance criteria

- Inspect the cited statute and exact pinned geoBoundaries source/feature; confirm the remote component and distinguish legal commune extent from a physical island outline.
- Inspect current atlas coordinates, member relationships, neighboring territory granularity and any Sala y Gómez point records; explain consequences without assuming that area/overlap alone settles correctness.
- Preserve original source evidence or exact restoration instructions, retrieval date, hashes, terms, pinned baseline inputs and a reproducible scoped method with positive/negative controls.
- Deliver a clear determination with uncertainty. If correction is supported, provide a bounded sourced engineering handoff; if not, explain why and retain a durable unresolved finding.
- Run the repository evidence-quality and scope checks applicable to the packet. Obtain an independent substantive review on the exact PR head. Submit one PR through the serialized merge queue.

## Dependencies and ownership

This child depends on completion of #405, which owns the initial 23-subject packet and this discovery. Do not begin the child until that dependency is satisfied and its exact source/baseline pins are available on main. This work owns only `data/regional-review/rapa-nui-sala-y-gomez-20261005/`.
